body.message:
Just to inform you, for a 1-year stay, we do not provide annual contracts or Ejari. However, you can continue your stay by extending on a monthly basis.

As we operate as holiday homes, we do not accept cheques. We can assist you with a 12-month booking; however, the payment terms will be as follows:

To secure and confirm the booking for 12 months, the first month’s rent, last month’s rent, and security deposit will need to be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we can reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

The remaining months can be paid on a monthly basis.
